# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [AGENTS-MCS.md](../AGENTS-MCS.md) and [docs/for-agents/HARD-RULES.md](../docs/for-agents/HARD-RULES.md). Use `NA-` Linear prefixes, never `NIA-`. HARD-RULES 3: publish/deploy tooling may be built and tested; public publish or deploy still needs Morgen's per-jurisdiction beta-gate sign-off (NA-269).

**Process insights (standing rule):** before finishing any session or PR, append your process insights (sources found, dead ends, data quirks, method findings, effort estimates, gaps) as new rows in `Spreadsheets/19-process-insights.csv`, with live-verified evidence. Append only. See [heavymap-planning/PROCESS-INSIGHTS.md](../heavymap-planning/PROCESS-INSIGHTS.md). If you cannot write to the repo, list them in your final message under the heading **Process insights**.
